name: Gmail
description: Business connector for Gmail (Google Workspace) through the Gmail API. Read-only by default (gmail.readonly); sending is a separate opt-in and always needs a person's approval.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID (Desktop app type) from the customer's Google Cloud project.

allowedDomain.description: Google Workspace domain the signed-in mailbox must belong to (e.g. example.co.jp). Sign-ins from other domains are refused.

send.description: Allow sending mail (gmail.send). Every send needs a person's approval.
